name: Netherweb Sildrea
bio: Sildrea’s aristocratic family feared the house crypts. Sildrea did not, and delved deep among the spiders to find the truth. She emerged with clarity: a dream for a better future for the Nocturna… and the power to weave it into a reality.

Charges through a 15x6m path towards the furthest enemy, damaging each enemy hit, dealing 135 damage.
Casts a [Stun] debuff on the targets, lasting 3s. Stunned targets cannot move or use Skills, take 100% damage as normal, and their Skill Cooldowns will behave as normal. Then, destroys the targets' MAX HP by 20% of the damage dealt. Will not destroy the target’s HP below 1% of their initial MAX HP. Then, casts a [15% Weaken] debuff on the targets, lasting 10s, increasing all damage taken by 15%.

Accuracy required for: Stun, Weaken

effects.label: Move SPD Down
effects.description: Decreases the recipient's Movement Speed by the indicated amount.

effects.label: Stun
effects.description: The recipient cannot move or attack, and Passive Skills are disabled.Active Skill cooldowns continue to count down as normal.The recipient will continue to take 100% damage from incoming attacks.

effects.label: Weaken
effects.description: Increase the damage the recipient takes from all attacks by the indicated percentage.
